body:
This PR resolves #6053.

It fixes `fft_based_implicit_free_surface_solver.jl` by naming the arguments instead of swallowing them, and adds the η source term to the right hand side exactly as the PCG kernel does.

Since the whole feature was untested (no test anywhere stepped a model with a non-zero `η` forcing for any free surface) the new `test/hydrostatic_free_surface/free_surface_forcing.jl` covers all four.
title: Apply η forcing in the FFT implicit free surface solver

body: Memory allocations bounds were tightened up in #6004, but it turns out that for the distributed case the memory allocations depend on the partition size (they're roughly the same for 4×1×1 and 1×4×1, but they tend to be larger for 2×2×1).  In #6004 I used as reference the first numbers I found, not realising that they were different the last partition tested.  With this PR we have different bounds for the different partitions, and update the values accordingly.  I'm running the distributed tests to make sure this is all set correctly.
